about: Bosch Limited engages in the manufacture and trading of automotive products in India. It operates through Automotive Products, Consumer Goods, and Others segments. The company offers products, such as spark and glow plugs; ignition coil; nozzle holder, components, and fuel rail assembly; LAG, SAG, rotary drill, hammer, and marble cutter; impact drilling machine; fuel injection pump and components; blower; and machines and components.
